# Sidrah Labs (سِدْرَة لابس)

> Sidrah Labs (سِدْرَة لابس) modernizes legacy ERPs and costly SaaS pipelines into AI-ready Databricks lakehouses—backed by pre-execution checks and formal verification research.

Data systems you can trust—and change safely.

Enterprises are bleeding budget on rented data connectors, stalled AI pilots over messy legacy ERPs, and fragile pipelines that break when changed at AI speed. Sidrah Labs delivers fixed-scope, AI-ready Databricks lakehouses powered by our internal verification toolchain—while researching formal verification for generated software and data.


## Operating Thesis

Pre-built toolchains compress delivery. Explicit contracts guarantee parity. Verification research makes change safe.

- **Deployments (Fixed-Scope Outcomes)**: Legacy ERP-to-Lakehouse migrations, Fivetran/SaaS cost off-ramps, and deterministic pipeline hardening in 10–21 days.
- **Toolchain (VPC-Deployed Accelerators)**: Reusable PySpark ingestion frameworks, row-hash parity engines, and pre-execution schema gates deployed directly in your cloud.
- **Research (Formal Verification)**: AST/SMT logic firewalls, symbolic execution (JPF/NeuroSPF), and mathematical proofs for AI-paced code and SQL mutations.

## Fixed-Scope Engagements

- **Legacy ERP & Unstructured Data to AI-Ready Lakehouse** (ENG-01 — 14–21 days): Most AI and analytics pilots stall because models are plugged into undocumented legacy databases and messy PDFs. We migrate locked-in SQL, Oracle, and ERP silos into a governed Databricks Medallion architecture—wired to a concrete BI, Genie, or MCP agent workflow.
  Deliverables:
  - Config-driven PySpark snapshot/merge ingestion & unstructured extraction
  - Reconciled Bronze, Silver, and AI-ready Gold layers with verified business rules
  - Zero-code table onboarding via metadata configuration
- **The 'Un-SaaS' Pipeline Off-Ramp (Cost & Ownership)** (ENG-02 — 14 days): Stop paying runaway monthly rent on your data. We replace metered SaaS connectors (like Fivetran) and full-recompute batch jobs with owned, incremental Python (dlt / PySpark) pipelines inside your VPC—cutting connector and DBU spend by up to 80%.
  Deliverables:
  - Self-hosted, zero-row-loss incremental ingestion inside your VPC
  - Mathematical row-hash and distribution parity against legacy tables
  - Elimination of third-party MAR billing spikes and vendor lock-in
- **Pipeline Hardening & Pre-Execution Contract Gates** (ENG-03 — 10–14 days): When engineers and AI coding agents ship SQL and pipeline edits at machine speed, syntax checks pass while join fan-outs, rounding errors, and schema drift silently corrupt production. We install deterministic pre-execution gates that block bad mutations before runtime.
  Deliverables:
  - Static AST query validation & explicit pre-execution schema contracts
  - Deterministic DataFrame business-rule and invariant assertions
  - Automated Golden-SQL regression & parity evaluation suites

Timelines are fixed sprint targets. Exact scope and mathematical parity guarantees are locked after technical discovery.

## Internal Toolchain

We do not start from a blank repository or bill hours to reinvent standard plumbing. Every engagement deploys our battle-tested software modules directly into your cloud estate—delivering in days what traditional consultancies take months to scope.

- **Metadata Ingestion & Un-SaaS Kit** (PKG / INGEST): High-concurrency PySpark and Python dlt frameworks for hostile ERP snapshot/merge diffing, API/document extraction, and zero-row-loss CDC reconciliation.
- **Deterministic Rules & Parity Engine** (PKG / PARITY): Modular DataFrame business-logic engine and automated row-hash/distribution checkers proving migrated tables mathematically match legacy financial ground truth.
- **Pre-Execution Schema & AST Gates** (PKG / GATES): Static query analysis and explicit contract assertions that intercept breaking schema drift, unsafe joins, and destructive DDL before queries touch Gold tables.

## Applied Research

As AI accelerates code and SQL generation by 240%+, the enterprise bottleneck shifts from writing software to proving a mutation is safe to run.

Without machine-checked verification, AI-paced engineering carries a poison pill: silent, catastrophic bugs in production. Sidrah Labs investigates AST/SMT-based query verification (Z3), relational algebra equivalence, and neuro-symbolic execution harnesses (extending JavaPathFinder and NeuroSPF) to build reusable logic firewalls that mathematically prove generated code patches and data transformations preserve strict business invariants prior to execution.


Key focus: AST/SMT query verification, relational algebra compilation, symbolic execution (JPF/NeuroSPF).

Flywheel: Real-world enterprise migrations expose hostile edge cases and undocumented failure modes. Those anonymized failure patterns become formal benchmarks in our research lab—continuously hardening the verification gates we deploy.

GitHub: https://github.com/sidrah-labs

## Field Notes & Production Experience

- **Zero-Downtime Self-Service ERP Lakehouse** (Enterprise Production — 2+ YRS): Architected and operated an end-to-end Databricks Medallion lakehouse across complex ERP financial and payroll schemas. Engineered a config-driven PySpark snapshot/merge framework and deterministic DataFrame rules engine running continuously for 2+ years without architectural regressions.
- **High-Concurrency HealthAI Extraction Infrastructure** (Silicon Valley HealthAI Team — 100+ SPIDERS): Engineered fault-tolerant extraction pipelines combining 100+ asynchronous extractors (bounded semaphores, custom rate-limit governors) with layout-aware PDF/table vision models to convert messy documents into schema-validated analytical tables.
- **Neuro-Symbolic & Symbolic Execution Research** (Formal Methods R&D — JPF / SMT): Applied formal-methods research extending JavaPathFinder (JPF) and NeuroSPF symbolic execution harnesses—bridging classical constraint solving with neural and LLM representations.

Verification Credential: Led by Muhammad Azeem — Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional.
